people.name: Achaia
people.line: A Roman province in southern Greece, including Corinth.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

people.name: Rome
people.line: Capital city of the Roman Empire

translations.web: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
translations.bsb: After these things had happened, Paul resolved in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. “After I have been there,” he said, “I must see Rome as well.”
translations.kjv: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
translations.asv: Now after these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
